items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I used to tell Charlie why don't you leave here and travel around, no, he stayed at Small's

ctx.x: Around the same time that Paul Whiteman has his great band, but they weren't giving black musicians, what I understand --
Who was the black -- Charlie Johnson had the band at Small's, he was great and this other guy was great.
